zh: 只需要对每个数单独数它十进制表示里有几个 0，再看个数是否为奇数。
反复取个位（x % 10）再除以 10，就能逐位访问一个正整数的每一位；唯一的特例是 0 本身：它的表示是 "0"，循环一次都不会执行，所以要单独算作含一个 0。
读入 n 个数（最大 10^18，用 64 位整数）。对每个 x：若 x == 0 则零的个数为 1，否则循环统计 x % 10 == 0 的次数；零的个数为奇数时答案加一，最后输出答案。
en: You only need to count, for each number on its own, how many 0 digits its decimal representation has, and check whether that count is odd.

Repeatedly taking the last digit (x % 10) and dividing by 10 visits every digit of a positive integer. The one special case is 0 itself: its representation is "0", but the loop never runs, so count it as containing one zero separately.

Read the n numbers (up to 10^18, so use 64-bit integers). For each x: if x == 0 the zero count is 1, otherwise count how many times x % 10 == 0 while dividing by 10. Add one to the answer when the zero count is odd, and print the answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Strip off the decimal digits of each number one by one and count the zeros; the number 0 is counted separately as containing one zero.

## Correctness

Each decimal digit of an integer is visited exactly once by taking the last digit modulo 10; the special case for 0 matches its standard representation, and the parity test is directly equivalent to the statement.

## Complexity

O(N log V) time and O(1) extra space.
